GMCONSOLE.Settings.RelayUrl.Name: Relay URL
GMCONSOLE.Settings.RelayUrl.Hint: Base URL of the gm-console relay, e.g. https://console.snieg.ovh or http://192.168.0.102:8765. Leave empty to disable.
GMCONSOLE.Settings.Enabled.Name: Enable console link
GMCONSOLE.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Connect this GM session to the relay so the tablet can fire macros.
GMCONSOLE.Settings.Pairing.Name: Tablet pairing
GMCONSOLE.Settings.Pairing.Label: Pair a tablet
GMCONSOLE.Settings.Pairing.Hint: Show a QR code to pair a new device and manage the ones already connected.
GMCONSOLE.Pairing.Title: GM Console — pair a tablet
GMCONSOLE.Notify.TokenRejected: GM Console: the relay rejected this token. Open Tablet pairing and enter the relay's bootstrap code again.
GMCONSOLE.Notify.NotMaster: GM Console: this token is a device token, not the master one. Open Tablet pairing and claim a master token.
GMCONSOLE.Notify.NoToken: GM Console: the relay URL is set but there is no token yet. Open Tablet pairing to connect.
GMCONSOLE.Notify.LayoutRejected: GM Console: a layout sent from the tablet was malformed and was not saved.
